summary: Iteration 37 - Comunicazioni module (courtesy invoice email, payment reminders, 3-level dunning). Backend: 25/25 pytest pass (config defaults/validation/persistence, cortesia auto ON/OFF on SDI consegnata, error logging without SMTP and for clients without email, manual cortesia 400/404, esegui with/without SMTP, dedupe + retry of errors, level selection, log order/stats/ultimo, real automatic daily loop (com_tick) executed once and set com_last_day, menu_off 403, fatture_attive module off 403, operatore 403 on PUT/esegui/cortesia). The OK path was checked against a local debug SMTP (127.0.0.1:1025): the subjects of the received emails were correct (cortesia, diffida, custom promemoria subject with placeholders filled in). Frontend: nav-comunicazioni, Dashboard com-panel/com-stats/com-panel-link, page switches/inputs/tabs/save/reload persistence, 422 toast, esegui confirm accept/dismiss, log refresh, menu-off hides nav+panel and redirects the direct URL - all working.

minor.issue: keys = [S{lv}-rata for x in todo for lv in range(1, liv+1)] uses the email's MAX level for every rata. A rata that is only level 1 (e.g. 10 days late) but sent in the same email as a level-3 rata gets S1,S2,S3 marked. It will never get its own 2nd/3rd sollecito later (verified: after changing livelli to [5,9,45] esegui returned solleciti=0). This may be intended (the rata was already in a diffida) but it differs from 'each rata gets each communication once'. Consider range(1, lv_x+1) per rata.

The automatic daily run and the automatic cortesia ignore company menu_off 'comunicazioni' (they only check moduli.fatture_attive). When the menu item is hidden, emails keep going out if the toggles were left ON.
Mixed timezones: _ledger 'today'/scaduta use the UTC date while the promemoria window uses the Rome date (oggi). Results can be off by one day between 00:00 and 01:00/02:00 Rome.

A manual run overwrites com_last_run, which the UI labels 'Ultimo invio pianificato'. Each failed manual retry also adds new error rows, so the 'N non inviate' 7-day counter keeps growing even after a later successful send (6 'non inviate' shown after a successful resend).
On failure the error detail is read from the company's most recent com_log row, not the row just written. Concurrent sends could return the wrong message. _send could return the error instead.

ui_bugs.issue: Not refreshed after 'Invia ora' (only the log reloads via logKey). It also shows manual runs under the 'pianificato' label.

When ora/giorni are out of range, the toast says 'Correggi i 2 campi evidenziati in rosso', but no field on this page is highlighted. The intro text also shows the unvalidated value ('dalle ore 25:00').

issues: The log table is cramped: badge and client columns wrap, rows are very tall, and the amount/esito columns are pushed off-screen into a horizontal scroll. Consider a stacked card layout on small screens.
The 'Ora invio' input sits inside the Promemoria card, but it also controls when solleciti are sent. Consider moving it to a general section.

action_items: Decide on and possibly fix the sollecito key marking so lower-level rate in a higher-level email are not marked with all levels (comunicazioni.py line 178)
Respect menu_off 'comunicazioni' in loop_tick and in the automatic cortesia hook
Use one date source (Rome) for both scaduta and the promemoria window
Refresh 'ultimo' after a manual run and label it differently from the scheduled run
Optional: improve the mobile layout of the ComLog table
critical_code_review_comments: comunicazioni.py:178 - keys are built with the max level for every todo rata (see backend minor issue)
comunicazioni.py:229 - error message for a failed manual cortesia comes from the latest log row (race condition)
loop_tick claims com_last_day before running; if run_company throws, that day is skipped with no retry (only logged)
server.py _push_status uses asyncio.create_task without keeping a reference (tasks can be garbage-collected; minor)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (minor UX issues only)

seed_data_creation: TEST_T37 companies, clients, invoices, com_log rows and one TEST_ operatore user were created and then all deleted (verified 0 left).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_iteration37_comunicazioni.py -v -n 0. For the OK email path, start a debug SMTP first: nohup python3 -m smtpd -n -c DebuggingServer 127.0.0.1:1025 & (Python 3.11 still has smtpd); otherwise the SMTP tests skip. test_auto_loop waits up to about 70s for the real backend loop (requires Rome hour >= 6). For UI: python tests/t37_ui_setup.py setup (prints cid, set localStorage fe_company_id) and python tests/t37_ui_setup.py clean <cid>. Note: Playwright page.fill on the controlled number inputs (com-livello-*) was once unreliable; click with click_count=3 and keyboard.type worked.
